_comment: Line-coverage targets for parsers and risk rules, checked by scripts/coverage_gate.py. Patterns are regexes on the source path with forward slashes, so they match src/ and core/src/. The first matching target wins. A target with ratchet_to is below its goal: threshold is the floor measured at the time (cargo llvm-cov 0.9.1, rounded down to a whole percent) and 'measured' is the exact value then. Raise a floor when coverage improves, never lower it, never set it above a measured value; remove ratchet_to and use 80 once the file reaches it. On 2026-11-20 (Windows, `cargo llvm-cov --workspace`) every target file reached 80%, so no target ratchets at the moment; the mechanism stays for the next file that falls short. workspace_threshold is the floor for all lines of the workspace together (OpenSSF Best Practices gold asks for 90%; 92% on 2026-11-25). The percentages count the #[cfg(test)] code in the same file, as the gate always has.
